answer: Pay peer-tip rewards through cluster-aware quadratic matching: before taking square roots, tips from agents that share a karst of hidden links (same funding wallet, gas source or timing) are summed as one donor. A nebula of 400 sybils tipping their own project then earns the match of a single donor, roughly 1/20 of what 400 honest agents would. To reach the zenith of the matching pool an attacker must build 400 truly unlinked funding paths, costing about $3 each plus weeks of separate history.
